route.description: An export of the route taken during the activity, if any. A GPX or TCX file. Reminder, all atproto blobs are public. And is recommended if you do this to trim start and end.

steps.description: The number of steps taken during the activity.

calories.description: The number of active calories burned during the activity.

distance.description: The distance covered during the activity, if any. This is a string to allow for float values. pace.social support is in feet and meters.

distanceUnits.description: The units used for distance measurement.

main.description: A recording of an activity. Like running, walking, lifting weights, etc. Helpful to create the rkey tid from the start time and clock id 23 so you can upsert easily.
